metadataRaw.title: Quick Crick in Neck Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares a super easy exercise to help get rid of a crick in your neck.

It’s perfect if you woke up with neck pain, a stiff neck, or are having trouble moving it.

Try it out and let us know how it goes!
